what_changed: Kilian asked for every carry-forward in VST's set to be rebuilt from economic drivers (11-17). Q3 FY2026 now uses the 10-Q (filed 11-09) instead of release estimates: retail 38.42 TWh (we had 38.30), fuel 21.42 $/MWh (we had 23.84), fixed costs 679 (we had 666), capacity 147 (we had 157), generation 65.59 TWh. Q4 FY2026 retail volume (29.46 TWh, was 31.06 from last year x the Q2 y/y ratio) is built by region: ERCOT's customer book is about 10% smaller than in 2025 after weather (Q3 was 121% of normal cooling vs 95% yet volume rose 0.8%), Northeast/Midwest about 7% smaller. Q4 fuel (21.40, was Q3 x last year's Q4/Q3) comes from the Nov-Dec gas book and Q3's measured other fuel costs; it is EBITDA-neutral. Q4 fixed costs (760, was Q3 x last year's Q4/Q3 = 706) = Q4 2025 x CPI 3.7% plus the Lotus stub and two months of Cogentrix; through the FY2026 base FY2027-28 fixed costs rise ~70 $M a year. FY2029 fuel and fixed costs, previously copies of FY2028, are priced: fuel from the 2029 vs 2028 Henry Hub futures, fixed costs with the Permian peakers' full year and Cleveland Fed expected inflation. Growth term refreshed (0.9789). Research target (12m) 139.25 -> 137.64 (-1.2%).
